newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates unchanged amid dull trading.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates unchanged amid dull trading.

text.p: Pakistani cotton market rates remained unchanged on Thursday in lacklustre trading on low demand from spinners, and dealers said price were likely to fall on arrival of 1997/98 (July-June) crop due next month.
They said selective buying from exporters helped keep the rates steady while spinners were on the sidelines.
"With the arrival of the new crop by next month, the prices are likely to remain under pressure," dealer Kishin Chand said.
In the kerb market, the K-68 variety was traded at 1,885 rupees ($46.62) per maund (37.32 kg) and the MHN-93 at 2,000 rupees.
